summary: Frontend-only verification of LOCKED Pricing v2 (/pricing). All 15 review criteria verified via DOM inspection + visual screenshot + live click navigation. Every data-testid is present, every verbatim price string appears, all badges render with role='status', both cycle tables (Journey/Companion) render with the locked rows + save tags, the Lantern card carries all 5 specified features, all 5 tier CTAs route to free pages only (/library or /grace/intro — none to /portal or any checkout), the voice explainer + 4 voice top-ups + honest note all render, accessibility attributes (<main>, <article aria-labelledby>, role=table) are correct, and the smoke click on 'Walk into Grace\u2019s room' navigates successfully to /grace/intro.

issues: Explore card looks visually empty in the lower half — the price+CTA block sinks to the bottom (mt-auto) leaving a large brass-coloured void above 'Free, always'. Cosmetic only; spacing is intentional for grid stretch but reads slightly awkward beside the dense Day Pass / Journey neighbours. Consider a quiet divider or a brand line to balance the column.

critical_code_review_comments: Pricing.jsx is ~670 lines — still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting TierCard / VoiceTopups / HonestNote into /components/pricing/* if more tiers/sections are added.
PriceLine renders 'regular price' label even when price.normal is undefined — currently guarded correctly, no bug.
The HTML entity in lantern feature list \"Behind the lanterns\" uses straight quotes — fine in UI; matches spec.
SOFT_LAUNCH is a module-level constant — when Anna flips it off it requires a redeploy; if a remote toggle is desired later, expose via env or feature-flag endpoint.
Cosmetic: Explore tier card visual height differs from neighbours because it has no cycles table; spacing reads slightly empty (see design_issues).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing v2 is locked and rendering exactly as specified in PRICING_LOCKED_2026-06-25_v2.md. CTAs intentionally route to free pages because Anna deferred the payment provider for 24h — do NOT regress these to /portal until Anna confirms the new provider. SOFT_LAUNCH=true in Pricing.jsx controls the soft-launch prices vs regular prices in the cycle tables. The lambda-based assertion harness used in this iteration produced false-negative 'object bool can't be used in await' errors for pre-computed booleans — diagnostic 'got <value>' strings still confirm every expected value matched; future agents should use direct `assert` on already-resolved values instead of wrapping them in lambdas.
